name: works.jobsweep/jobsweep
title: JobSweep
description: Search 1.9M+ open jobs from 32,000+ company career sites, linked to the original. Free tier.

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description:
Search open jobs across all indexed career sites (duplicates merged). Use
        list_filter_values for valid filter values and get_job for a job's full description.

        Returns `jobs` (id, title, company, location, remote, employment_type, salary text and
        `salary_range` with numeric min, max, currency, period and yearly_min/yearly_max (null
        without a stated period: such amounts are not comparable), posted_at, first_seen_at, url,
        company_url, apply_url) newest or most relevant first, `next_cursor` and `complete`
        (false: the search ran out of time and `jobs` holds only what was found in time, title
        and company matches or nothing; retry or narrow the filters). For the next page repeat
        the call with the same filters and `cursor` set to `next_cursor`; null means the last
        page.

q.description: Full-text query in web search syntax: "quoted phrases", OR, -exclude and (parentheses). `-word` excludes it from the whole query, or from the parentheses it stands in. Omit to list the newest jobs.
q.title: Q

location.description: Matches city, region or country text of the job location, e.g. `Berlin` or `Germany`.
location.title: Location

remote.description: Work mode as stated by the employer, or `unknown` for jobs that state none (about two in three); see list_filter_values for counts.
remote.title: Remote

employment_type.description: Employment type; see list_filter_values for counts.

posted_after.description: ISO 8601 timestamp with timezone; jobs posted or first seen after it.
posted_after.title: Posted After

has_salary.description: Only jobs whose posting states a salary.
has_salary.title: Has Salary

min_salary.description: Only jobs whose posted salary range reaches this yearly amount in `salary_currency` (USD unless given), e.g. 180000. Hourly, daily, weekly and monthly pay is converted to a year; a salary without a stated period never matches.
min_salary.title: Min Salary

salary_currency.description: ISO 4217 code such as `EUR`; only jobs with a salary in it.
salary_currency.title: Salary Currency

limit.description: Jobs per page, 1-50 (1-25 without an API key).
limit.title: Limit

cursor.description: `next_cursor` from the previous call with the same filters.
cursor.title: Cursor

tools.name: get_job
tools.description:
Get one job in full: plain-text description (truncated to 8000 characters), salary,
        `open` and `closed_at`, `last_seen_at` (when a crawl last saw it open), every source
        posting it was merged from and their change history. Call after search_jobs with a
        job_id, or with a link. To only check whether a link is still open use
        check_job_link.

job_id.description: Job `id` from search_jobs, or a JobSweep job link such as https://jobsweep.works/jobs/145524, or the job's apply or source link.
job_id.title: Job Id

tools.name: check_job_link
tools.description:
Is this job posting still open? Takes a link (not an id) and answers `open` true or
        false with `closed_at` and `last_seen_at` (when a crawl last saw it open), how long it
        was open and whether the same title at the company was posted before. `found` is false
        when the link is not in the index; then JobSweep cannot say. Use get_job for the
        description.

url.description: Link to a job posting: the employer's apply or source link, or a JobSweep job link.
url.title: Url

tools.name: list_filter_values
tools.description:
List the values accepted by the `remote` and `employment_type` filters of
        search_jobs with open job counts, plus top countries (ISO code, name) and companies.
        Call before search_jobs when you need valid filter values.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description:
Find companies by name with their number of open jobs, largest first. Pass a
        returned name as `company` to search_jobs to list that company's jobs.

limit.description: Maximum companies to return, 1-50 (1-25 without an API key).
limit.title: Limit

tools.name: index_stats
tools.description:
Size and freshness of the index: open jobs, postings, career sites, live platforms,
        last successful crawl and recent crawl success rate. Not for finding jobs; use
        search_jobs.

tools.name: get_coverage
tools.description:
Which hiring platforms (ATS) are covered and whether they work: status (`live`,
        `blocked`, `no live deployments`, `no connector`, `no tenants`), career sites, open
        jobs and last successful crawl. `required` is true for platforms on the challenge list of 78
        and false for additional ones. Not for finding jobs; use search_jobs.

status.description: Only platforms with this status; omit for all platforms.
status.title: Status
